metadata.select: openFemaDataSet, datasetVersion, name, type, description, isSearchable

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: disasterNumber
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Sequentially assigned number used to designate an event or incident declared as a disaster. For more information on the disaster process visit https://www.fema.gov/disasters/how-declared

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: declarationDate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Date the disaster was declared

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: incidentType
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Type of incident such as fire or flood. The incident type will affect the types of assistance available. For more information on incident types, please visit: https://www.fema.gov

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: pwNumber
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Sequentially assigned number used to identify a unique project

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: applicationTitle
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Standard, non-unique (free form text) application title

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: applicantId
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Unique Public Assistance applicant identification number

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: damageCategoryCode
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Code representing the type of work eligible for reimbursement through a Public Assistance grant; for a full listing of each category please go to https://www.fema.gov/assistance/public/program-overview

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: damageCategoryDescrip
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Damage category code related to the Damage Category Description

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: projectProcessStep
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The current process location of a project from formulation through closeout including pending stages, discontinuation and obligation.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: projectSize
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Projects are designated as Large or Small, which can affect a number of variables in case management (processing). Project size is determined by the eligible amount as set in the damage survey

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: county
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The name of a U.S. county, parish, borough, independent city or other political subdivision specifying the applicant location. Counties may not be available for tribal, territories or applicants lacking specified headquarter locations.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: countyCode
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Unique identifier for a U.S. county; typically, this identifier makes up the last three digits of a five digit Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) Code

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: stateAbbreviation
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Two-character unique identifier for a U.S. state or territory

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: stateNumberCode
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Unique identifier for a U.S. state or territory; this identifier makes up the first two digits of a five digit Federal Information Processing Standard (FIPS) Code

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: projectAmount
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The estimated total cost of the Public Assistance grant project in dollars, without administrative costs. This amount is based on the damage survey.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: federalShareObligated
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The Public Assistance grant funding available to the grantee (State) in dollars, for sub-grantee's approved Project Worksheets

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: totalObligated
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The federal share of the Public Assistance grant eligible project amount in dollars, plus grantee (State) and sub-grantee (applicant) administrative costs. The federal share is typically 75% of the total cost of the project

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: mitigationAmount
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Public Assistance proposed amount that applies to 406 mitigation. Note: does not capture some HMP proposals in the cost lines. Some negative values may exist and are due to adjustments between mitigation costs and project costs, deobligations within versions, and incorrectly categorized mitigation cost lines.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: lastRefresh
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Date the record was last updated in the API data store

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: hash
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: MD5 Hash of the fields and values of the record

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: lastObligationDate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Date the grant was last obligated

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: firstObligationDate
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Date the grant was initially obligated

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: gmProjectId
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The numeric project identification number used in GM for individual projects.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: gmApplicantId
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: The numeric applicant identification number used in GM that represents an applicant in a declaration.

OpenFemaDataSetFields.name: projectStatus
OpenFemaDataSetFields.description: Status of the project reflecting project eligibility.
